title: Hanging Leg Raise
summary: A hanging raise of the legs or knees for the abs.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for abs (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.5 for obliques (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly obliques total.
Library rating 0.3 for forearms (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Hang from a bar with your arms straight.
Tilt your pelvis back and raise your knees or straight legs.
Curl your hips up toward your chest.

form_cues.cue: Curl the pelvis up as the legs rise
Raise legs to at least hip height
Curling your pelvis up is what works the abs. Just lifting your legs mostly works the hip flexors.

mistakes.text: Swinging the legs instead of curling the hips.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
